name: pair-programmer
description: A shared office for teammate agents. See who is working on what, stop two agents doing the same job, and hand work to whoever is free. Runs on your own network, no cloud service and no account.
author: isHeSatoshi
exampleQueries: Check who is working on what in the office before I start.
Claim this task so nobody else duplicates it.
Delegate this task to the teammate's agent that is free.
